transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, that sounds correct. My recovery has been smooth and my eye is feeling fine overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great, thanks for confirming.

Summary of our conversation:

- Eye redness: Not present.
